description: Reconstruct a PARTIAL function/event interface for an EVM contract on a supported EVM chain from its BYTECODE — no source or verification needed. Extracts PUSH4 function selectors + recent event topic0 hashes and resolves the ones public signature DBs (openchain/4byte) know to human signatures. Works on UNVERIFIED contracts because bytecode is ground truth, but it is NOT a full ABI: novel/proprietary selectors DBs have never seen stay unresolved (decompile for those). Use it to understand what an unknown contract does before trusting behavior-based guesses.
